    Candy - Sessions
    Kim Petras

    Description
    Candy is a scrapped studio album by Kim Petras. It was meant to be a replacement for the (then) shelved album Problématique, before it ended up being ultimately scrapped, as it never made it further than being a concept.
    (description from here)

    Information
    Recorded: 2015 - 2022
    Formats: .mp3
    Total Tracks: 10
    Discs: 2
    Rar Size: 76.72 MB

    1. Control
    2. Candy
    3. Tough Luck
    4. Dirty Dirty
    5. Gimme Sum
    6. Say Something
    7. Crave It
    8. Fascination
    9. Pressure
    10. Choker (Rework)
    11. Eventually
    12. Finessed It
    13. Official Girl

    1. Control (Demo 1)

    Disc 2 - Extras
    1. Choker (Acoustic) [Live from 2020 Instagram Live]

    Notes
    The artwork is not official at any means, and it was made by me

    The exact date for when she performed Choker live on Instagram is March 17th, 2020
